scientific_integrity: A complete three-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé proof establishes the infinite statement; three reproducible programs verify independent finite cases and sharp boundary sentences. No experimental extrapolation is used for the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Finite Brandt semigroups over the trivial group only; named absorbing zero and ternary relational multiplication; quantifier rank three only. It is not a theorem for functional multiplication, extra predicates, nontrivial coefficient groups or higher ranks. Exhaustive historical priority and independent validation remain open.
title: Five rank-three theories of finite Brandt matrix-unit semigroups
